requirement.canonicalVariables: ship_operates_in_polar_waters, ship_type, length_overall_m, gross_tonnage, engaged_in_trade, chapter_11_1_applicable
requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_operates_in_polar_waters = true, THEN chapter_11_1_applicable = true when (ship_type = fishing_vessel AND length_overall_m >= 24) OR (ship_type = pleasure_yacht AND gross_tonnage >= 300 AND engaged_in_trade = false) OR (ship_type = cargo_ship AND 300 <= gross_tonnage < 500).
requirement.requiredInputs: Operating area, ship type, length, gross tonnage, and trade status
requirement.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirement.sourceText: This chapter applies to the following ships operating in polar waters: fishing vessels of 24 metres in length overall and above; pleasure yachts of 300 gross tonnage and upwards not engaged in trade; and cargo ships of 300 gross tonnage and upwards but below 500 gross tonnage.
